vetSays.line: A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Company makes the road shorter.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 60s telling A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm about A woman, maybe 30s, with calloused knuckles. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm came back with 468 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling A man, maybe 40s about Rachel. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
💧 A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +2 clean.
A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.
"You haven't earned that yet," A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm says. (Trust too low.)
...and then it lands: A woman, maybe 50s, with a burn-scarred forearm speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
🛡️ Nora, Maureen, Mariana, Rafik and Sofia met them at the door — 5 put down. Nora, Maureen, Mariana, Rafik, Sofia are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mariana, Rafik and Sofia met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Mariana, Rafik, Sofia are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jorge just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Nora, Maureen, Sofia, Elif and Jorge met them at the door — 4 put down. Maureen didn't come back. Nora, Sofia, Elif, Jorge are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Sofia taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Sofia passes around European Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
Caleb: "Walked past a good stand of european elder. Worth remembering where."
🛡️ Sari, Nikolai and Adwoa met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sari, Nikolai, Adwoa are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
